handoff.summary: Live at https://squiggle-cup.ksmostofa576.workers.dev/. Current direction: the white architectural sheet, a straight 40 m race in five lanes; drawings decide movement, no race controls or luck. Fixed the game URL serving relay text by deploying static assets through a separate game Worker config. npm run deploy now checks the game HTML. Drawing PNGs have an opaque white background; result cards remain 1080x1350. Logo displayed and 1200x630 OG still added. Fixed host handoff on results, guest-only control visibility, stale screen refresh callbacks, and departed entrants appearing in rematches. npm test, npm run build and all three Playwright checks pass locally and against the live URL: three isolated browsers draw distinct creatures, agree on results, run three identical-time rematches, download PNGs, and finish another race after the host leaves. No demo or OG video created, per user request.
next: Owner: run a three-person playtest on different devices/networks; automation used three isolated Chromium contexts on one machine
Owner: complete Devpost submission and trmi write-up; demo and OG videos were explicitly excluded
Later: check Firefox/WebKit determinism and native phone share sheets
open: Three contexts on one machine do not replace a three-person, different-network playtest
